About this project

A public experiment.

We want to find out whether careful, evidence-based football analysis can produce useful probability estimates over time.

Why this exists

Football prediction websites often highlight only winners. We preserve the original pick and recorded odds before the match, disclose when the written explanation was added later, and preserve the result after it finishes. Anyone can inspect both the successes and failures.

What we stand for

Free access, a single market (1X2), no invented performance data, and a clear separation between the daily featured favourite and an actual value pick. Predictions are never guaranteed outcomes or investment recommendations.

How the project is funded

This first version is a free research project with no paid subscription, bookmakers or affiliate partnerships.

Important note

All forecasts are uncertain. Never treat the posted odds as live prices. No real-money bets are placed as part of this project.
